question: Do tuned fixed and feedback SafeCEM recover safe task completion and use fewer actions than original SafeCEM at the same requested margin on PushT and original OGBench Cube?
cube_task: Original cube object must be within 0.04 m of its goal position, not effector reaching. LeWM dataset-pair goals at +25 steps; separately report nontrivial moving-cube pairs and initially solved pairs in a benchmark-context panel. Do not claim the full official five-goal OGBench leaderboard protocol.
pusht_task: Retain the pinned swm/PushT-v1 termination rule: joint pusher/block planar position error <20 px and block angle error <pi/9. Recompute from saved states. Do not label the negative-distance reward as coverage.

checker.pusht: Known linear pusher PD path at every physics substep, anchored to current state.
checker.cube: Commanded-path approximation for population ranking plus a true-simulator check of the executable five-action prefix; up to eight ordered candidates, restore full simulator state between checks. Same checker for every checked method. Record counterfactual interactions separately.
checker.authority: Neither adapter nor search can lower the requested margin. No unchecked fallback.
checker.safety_predicate: Pusher centre or Cube gripper pinch point inside a planar keep-out band; not whole-body collision certification.

geometry.frame: Direction from start to goal pusher (PushT), or start to goal cube (Cube), with perpendicular axis; two finite rectangular pillars form a band and gap.
geometry.case_admission: Use state metadata only; no outcome-based acceptance. Start and requested goal positions must be outside the maximum inflated hazard. Keep rejection reasons. Cube planar object displacement >=0.08 m; PushT object displacement >=20 px and start not already successful.

engineering.purpose: Native/action parity, goal predicate, rendering/state replay, dense monitor, Cube preview restoration, and runtime. Repair errors within this allowance; low task success is recorded and does not cancel the comparison.

development.feedback_base: Selected fixed setting per environment and margin; repair horizon min(base,2), stall horizon 3, exploration multiplier 2, stall retention 0.5.
development.selection: Maximize safe completions, then minimize safe-failure-capped actions, predictor work and candidate index; break ties deterministically. Select without final-case access.

final.admission: Before development outcomes, choose largest tier fitting measured engineering timings with 50% runtime contingency and 40 minutes reserved for preservation. Do not change tier based on efficacy.
final.native: Run once per case/seed and score under all three margins, without duplicating it as independent evidence.
final.paired: Same frozen cases, planner seeds and host for all methods; method job order randomized in blocks.

metrics: actions and simulated seconds among safe successes
speed: J_safe equals executed actions on requested-safe completion and 50 otherwise, including unsafe successes and early failures. Conditional safe-success speed is secondary and always accompanied by its success denominator. Report actual wall-clock and compute separately; no video-playback speed claim.
uncertainty: Paired resampling over complete case blocks, preserving seeds and margins. Prespecified descriptive contrasts fixed-canonical and feedback-fixed for safe completion and J_safe; clustered intervals and denominators. No success-only ranking or claim of evolutionary superiority.
preservation: New outputs/lewm18 and receipts; periodic local sync; hash-verified archive before destroying this rental. Existing historical records unchanged.

execution_amendment.reason: Large public input downloads delayed Cube; completed PushT engineering permits its independent campaign to proceed.
execution_amendment.schedule: Choose full or compact tier separately for each environment, using only its engineering timings before its development outcomes. Same contingency and preservation reserve.
execution_amendment.hosts: All efficacy methods, development selection and serial timing for one environment remain on one host. Do not pool cross-host timing or repeat selected efficacy on a faster host.
execution_amendment.budget: Both authorized rentals remain within the original $5 aggregate and common deadline.
